Defines GenerationResult domain model for generation outcome.

class gen_um_test.core.model.generation_result.GenerationResult(success: bool, output_dir: str = '', generated_files: tuple[str, ...] = (), message: str = '', interfaces_count: int = 0)[source]¶

Bases: object

Domain model representing outcome of generation operations.

Parameters:

  • success – Whether the operation succeeded.

  • output_dir – Directory where files were generated.

  • generated_files – Sequence of absolute or relative file paths created.

  • message – Status or error message.

  • interfaces_count – Number of interfaces processed.
